symptoms.text: We queued push notifications for a donation campaign last week and as far as we can tell none of them ever went out. No errors on our side — we got 202s back.
A couple of our supporters said they got the same confirmation email twice. Only a handful, not everyone.
Email sends looked really slow starting the morning of March 9th. Someone said it was probably the sender deploy that day. Never confirmed.
When I open a trace for an SMS message I only ever see the first two services. Where does the rest of it go?
Honestly the logs are unusable. I scroll for a minute and it's all health checks.
